title: Release quest-cli 0.8.0: version bump, CI-built platform binaries, qualification, tag
description: 29 commits sit on dev unpublished since the 0.7.1 hotfix freeze (2026-09-15), including QCLI-297's breaking removal-fails-loud change plus several Added/Fixed entries. The gap has cost the fleet three independent orchestrator-session investigations of the same already-fixed bug (--remove-note silent no-op) because every fresh session installs the published npm binary. QCLI-328 establishes that a Changed (breaking) CHANGELOG entry should correspond to at least a minor bump, so this releases as 0.8.0, not 0.7.2. Follow docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md: strings-then-bytes version bump (two commits), CI-built platform binaries via prepublication-qualification.yml dispatch, full qualification record, changelog finalization at tag time, native-execution receipt. Stops at 'ready to publish' -- the actual npm publish needs separate explicit owner authorization per that runbook's Prerequisites and is not covered by this task.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Strings commit lands: package.json, src/application/version.ts, src/contract/tracker/index.ts QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, optionalDependencies pins, and each platform manifest .version all read 0.8.0; bun run check:packages exits 0 in this intermediate state

CI-built platform binaries for all six targets are committed with matching questBinarySha256/questPlatformPackages checksums, bun.lock updated, and CLAUDE.md managed Quest block regenerated against the freshly built darwin-arm64 binary
bun run check exits 0 and the full qualification record (type, format, layer, unit, contract, integration, package, checksum, repository-identity) is attached as evidence
CHANGELOG.md Unreleased section is renamed to ## 0.8.0 with a fresh empty ## Unreleased heading added above it, in the tag-time commit
v0.8.0 tag is pushed and prepublication-qualification.yml dispatched against it with a passing native-execution receipt downloaded and verified via receipt:require
Task explicitly stops short of npm publish and records that step 7 (publish) is pending direct owner authorization
